test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide

which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All clouds are waters.

Some waters are juices.

All juices are sugars.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some clouds are sugars.

II. Some waters are sugars.

III. Some waters are clouds.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
